relevance_note: Case report of a 39-year-old man with type 1 diabetes and oral and genital ulcers in whom whole-exome sequencing found "a c.1467_1468delinsAT heterozygous mutation in the gene TNFAIP3", and who was diagnosed with HA20; Table 2 adds four previously published HA20 patients with T1DM (P1-P4).
method_note: Read only the paper, the schema and the rules; no script was used, all table cells were transcribed by hand from the Markdown and checked against it. Individuals: the case-report patient is labelled 'patient' (the single unnamed patient of a case report); he is column P5 of Table 2 ('Reference ... This study'). P1-P4 are the four previously published HA20+T1DM patients of Table 2, labelled from the table's column headers, with source_reference_in_review copied from the table's 'Reference' row. The patient's parents and sister (tested, variant-negative) are in scope as relatives; no variants rows were made for them because the paper states they do not carry the variant, and that testing is quoted in the patient's parental_testing_statement. Contradiction found: Table 2 prints '| Arthralgia | NM | yes | no | no | yes |' (yes for P2 and P5) while the text says 'these five patients did not present with other clinical manifestations of HA20, including early onset IBD, muscle-skeletal disorders with arthralgia and arthritis, and recurrent fever'; both readings are emitted as phenotypic_features rows and the checklist item 'arthritis or arthralgia' is 'not reported' for P2 and for the patient. Group statement: 'these five patients' covers P1-P5 (the counts 4/5 oral ulcers and 3/5 AITD match Table 2), so 'recurrent fever', 'early onset IBD' and 'muscle-skeletal disorders with arthralgia and arthritis' were marked excluded for all five with evidence_basis 'inferred from group statement'. Counts without names ('117 cases', '5/118', '4/5', '3/5') were not used to exclude anyone. No cell in this paper contains ' / ', so there are no stacked cells. The paper does not call the patient's CRP (5.8 mg/L against a printed range 0-6) normal, so 'elevated inflammatory markers (CRP/ESR)' is left 'not reported' for him. P1's 'enteropathy' was not mapped onto the checklist item 'gastrointestinal ulcers or inflammation' (left 'not reported'). The patient's age at onset was taken from Table 2 ('Age at the appearance of initial symptoms ... 5'); the case report only says the ulcers occurred 'since early childhood'. age_at_diagnosis uses the stated age at diagnosis of type 1 diabetes (19 years); the paper gives no age at HA20 diagnosis. source_reference_in_review is 'not reported' for the patient although the Table 2 cell reads 'This study', because the schema reserves that field for previously published people. 'Electromyography, cardiac and vascular color Doppler ultrasound, and abdominal color Doppler ultrasound were normal' and 'His parents are healthy' are normal/unaffected findings as a whole and were not used to exclude any specific checklist item.
